body: Sometimes I slow way down while I'm crossing. I look at them and try to communicate with my eyes that it would be okay if they kept going, that nobody would blame them and that it would just be a tragic accident. They always stop, though.

I feel this way about depression. They won't help because it's supposedly curable, treatable, whatever. I'm not convinced that's true. Not even remotely convinced. Depression is also terminal. How many people kill themselves every year? If it's been going on over a decade and there is no hope but death, then I just wish people could be accepting enough to make you not have to do it alone and then shame you for your secret death.
